peer_summary: The exact V3.2 additive policy materially repairs the V3.1 boss findings for observation/checker ordering across every represented evidence class, same-volume identity disjointness, declared enumeration API/status/count/digests and opened-row derivation, same lease and boot continuity, whole-lease and interphase dual-clock bounds, strict integer representation, canonical continuity hashing, and authority nonclaims. All nine exact direct semantic functions pass without pytest. Qualification nevertheless fails. First, the asserted identities_from_model arrays are never proven to be parent-child relations: an arbitrary unique same-volume directory identity can replace an intermediate ancestor, all detached hashes can be recomputed, and prepare still passes. Second, the full-system snapshot remains a caller-authored canonical object with self-authenticating count/digests/status; both a two-row snapshot and a three-row snapshot with an unrelated process pass, so omission of an unrepresented system row is not detectable, normalized process names are not derived from raw enumerator names, and the declared NtQuerySystemInformation/SystemProcessInformation API is paired with ERROR_NO_MORE_FILES rather than a coherent API-specific completion result. Third, the frozen V3.2 policy dynamically imports and executes sibling V3.1 bytes without checking their hash, so the V3.2 policy SHA does not alone bind its executable semantics. These are fresh component and production-closure blockers, not authority escalations or requests for live action.

affirmed_repairs.evidence: Every target, sentinel, process, parent, environment, effect, system_snapshot and topology subject must have exactly one digest-bound attestation inside the checker interval on both clocks. The shipped every-class after-checker adversarial function rejected each class.

The policy binds volume/workspace/model, parents, targets and sentinels to one volume and rejects duplicate identity keys across directory and file classes. The shipped cross-volume and file-parent-alias function passed. Finding T550-V9-V3-2-POLICY-PEER-001 addresses the missing parent-child ancestry relation.

The policy closes the row schema, ordinal/PID uniqueness, declared raw count, rows digest, derived-candidate digest, opened-evidence digest and exact opened projection. The shipped API/status/count/digest and represented-candidate omission negatives pass. Finding T550-V9-V3-2-POLICY-PEER-002 addresses unrepresented system-row omission and collector provenance.

Prepare and publish require the same opaque lease ID, boot identity and lease origins; validation on each phase is bounded by one maximum lease and wall/monotonic skew tolerance; the interphase gap is nonnegative and skew-bounded. The shipped lease, boot and whole-lease negatives pass, and source inspection confirms the interphase comparison.

The strict numeric walk rejects floats globally and requires all represented integer-valued positive-fixture keys to be non-boolean integers in [0, 2^63-1]. The shipped float, boolean, negative and overflow substitutions pass as rejection tests. Prepare and publish compare an exact canonical continuity SHA-256 and reject prepare-result substitution.

Green prepare and publish remain machine-only. effect_authorized and publication_authorized are false, canonical_execution_blocked is true, hidden_writer_exclusion_proven and opaque_lease_verified_by_pure_policy are false, and candidate_only/non_authorizing remain true.

findings.title: Rooted topology validates a same-volume identity list, not ancestry relations
findings.evidence: For each nonroot parent, the policy checks only that identities_from_model has the same length as path-token components, that each row is a same-volume non-reparse directory identity, and that the last identity equals the asserted canonical parent identity. It contains no child-parent identity edge, retained-handle relation, open-relative relation, or descendant-closure proof. A fresh probe replaced book_chunks in the book_chunks/Hos chain with a new unique same-volume directory identity, recomputed all_identity_keys_sha256, observation digests, sidecar continuity and detached hashes, and the exact policy accepted prepare.
findings.risk: An unrelated same-volume directory can be presented as an intermediate ancestor. Logical component count plus a terminal identity does not prove that any chain is rooted beneath the frozen model directory, so the V3.1 boss requirement for retained-handle parent-chain relations and calculated descendant closure is not met.
findings.required_repair: Represent and validate each adjacent root-to-child relation with collector-produced retained-handle/open-relative evidence, bind every edge to exact parent and child identities, calculate descendant closure inside policy, and add arbitrary-same-volume-intermediate, reordered-chain and disconnected-chain negatives in a newly named generation.

findings.title: Full-system enumeration completeness and process-name derivation remain asserted
findings.evidence: The policy receives rows, raw_count, rows_sha256, API identity and terminal status from the same canonical sidecar and checks only their internal agreement. It has no independently frozen collector receipt, call sequence, buffer-completion evidence, raw enumerator image-name field, or normalization derivation. Two fresh probes both passed: the original two-row asserted snapshot, and a three-row snapshot with an unrelated process after recomputing raw_count, rows_sha256, derived_candidate_sha256, observation, continuity and detached hashes. Therefore a caller can equally submit the two-row version while silently omitting the third row. In addition, the frozen constant pairs NtQuerySystemInformation/SystemProcessInformation with ERROR_NO_MORE_FILES, an incoherent terminal contract for that API family rather than a collector-specific successful complete-buffer result.
findings.risk: The policy cannot distinguish a complete system inventory from a self-consistent subset, and caller-authored normalized_name controls whether a row enters the bounded candidate set. This repeats the substance of the V3.1 completeness blocker despite improved row derivation. Honest hidden-writer nonclaims contain authority but do not qualify the component.
findings.required_repair: Bind an independently reviewed collector artifact and exact loaded bytes; define a coherent API-specific enumeration completion contract; include raw image-name evidence and deterministically derive normalized names inside policy; bind call/buffer/completion evidence and an external capture identity; then add alternate-self-consistent-subset, raw-name/normalized-name mismatch, incomplete-buffer and terminal-status negatives.

findings.title: The frozen V3.2 policy SHA does not bind the V3.1 policy bytes it executes
findings.evidence: At import time, V3.2 loads rematerialization_live_gate_policy_v3_1.py from a sibling pathname and executes it. The V3.2 module does not hash those bytes before execution or bind an independently supplied expected V3.1 policy SHA. The V3.2 freeze lists the V3.2 policy and tests but does not list the loaded V3.1 policy as a direct artifact. Consequently identical V3.2 bytes and SHA can execute different base semantics if the sibling V3.1 file changes.
findings.risk: The exact frozen policy hash is not a complete semantic identity. Direct test success proves the current workspace combination only and cannot qualify the V3.2 component as a byte-exact additive policy.
findings.required_repair: Make the frozen base policy a direct hash-bound dependency of the new generation, verify its bytes before module execution through a separately reviewed loader, and include the exact base hash in the freeze/component graph and adversarial dependency-drift tests.

direct_semantic_reproduction.execution_method: Imported the exact hashed test module with bytecode writing disabled and invoked each test_* function directly; then ran pure in-memory adversarial probes against rebuilt canonical bytes and detached hashes.

preserved_appeals_and_dissent.position: V3.2 is materially safer than rejected V3.1 and closes the exact shipped counterexamples for observation order, cross-volume/file-parent aliasing, lease chronology and numeric continuity.
preserved_appeals_and_dissent.reason: Those repairs are genuine and reproducible. Failure of the generation does not erase them or authorize transitive rejection of the repaired invariants.

preserved_appeals_and_dissent.position: A trusted collector can truthfully supply identities_from_model as a real ancestry chain and supply a genuinely complete system snapshot.
preserved_appeals_and_dissent.reason: That may be true of a future collector, but the exact policy neither binds that collector nor represents the adjacency facts needed to distinguish a real chain or complete inventory from recomputed assertions.

preserved_appeals_and_dissent.position: The predecessor freeze indirectly records the V3.1 policy hash, so the V3.2 dynamic import is reviewable.
preserved_appeals_and_dissent.reason: A human can trace the predecessor artifact, but the V3.2 runtime does not verify that hash before executing the sibling module and the V3.2 freeze does not directly bind the loaded dependency.

preserved_appeals_and_dissent.position: Pure policy cannot itself prove a system API call or retained-handle fact, so the self-consistent sidecar is an appropriate boundary.
preserved_appeals_and_dissent.reason: A pure policy may consume collector evidence, but qualification requires a separately frozen collector/loader and evidence schema that represents the required facts. Current nonclaims correctly prevent authority escalation.

preserved_strict_writer_race_dissent.reason: Even a repaired collector-bound snapshot and handle-relative ancestry proof cannot exclude every pre-opened, future, hidden, renamed, kernel, sync, ancestor-thread or noncooperating writer, nor eliminate every precheck-to-rename lost update or post-readback stale-state race.
